building: Ray W. Herrick Laboratories (2013 research building)

official_gis.provider: Purdue University campus GIS ArcGIS FeatureServer, BuildingShapesZip4 layer 0
official_gis.source_crs: EPSG:4326 response; original Purdue service uses EPSG:3857/102100 (as identified in prior project source docs)
official_gis.measurement_method: Official GIS ring transformed by project local geographic linear approximation, duplicate/collinear vertices simplified with iterative maximum local point-to-segment deviation tolerance 0.25m; horizontal origin is the original footprint bbox center.
official_gis.transform: X=(longitude - -86.9137) * 84810.6041653993 m/degree; Y=(latitude - 40.4274) * 111040.0 m/degree; Z up in meters; this is approximate project frame, not a surveyed CRS
official_gis.uncertainty: GIS service gives no survey tolerance/date; vertex accuracy and wall-to-outline association unverified; overhangs not represented.

architectural_references.published_facts: This manifest record matches Purdue GIS FID878 / HLAB / 177 S Russell Street and the 2013 68,000-sq-ft new building. A separate manifest record massing_herrick_laboratories_2138103 matches FID246 / HERL “Herrick Acoustics”, the distinct historic 1920s barn building; these are distinct adjacent facilities within the lab complex, not duplicate IDs. Model only HLAB here. Three stories from current visual/source descriptions; roof height estimated.
architectural_references.google_maps_streetview: Not directly inspected in this subtask; image sources used where cited; model detail claims limited accordingly.

revision_sources.title: Purdue News — Herrick Labs building opens
revision_sources.observation: Supports the distinct 2013 HLAB facility; high-bay wing, duct risers, loading glazing and lab equipment remain schematic. The older Herrick Acoustics building is not included.

validation.reopen_check: Saved, reopened from the saved .blend in Blender 5.2.3, and rerendered from that reopened scene; stable collection, placement_origin_xy_m, geometry, materials and source-file hash checked.

notes: Added a distinct metal high-bay wing, visible test rigs, loading glazing and roof equipment; specific rig layout is schematic.
Kept brick office/lab bays distinct from metal high-bay walls, trimmed generic windows/facade fins to the parapet, and added schematic work surfaces.
Retained the distinct 2013 HLAB source match and GIS outline; did not include the separate historic HERL building.

Added a warm schematic vestibule cue behind the glazed entry, plus a short entry walk and paired low planters. Interior room layout, site furniture, and planting placement are interpretive, not survey-derived.
